observation: How much rain accumulated near Palmira, Colombia (76.36° W, 3.53° N), on 21–31 October 2026? For final CHIRPS v3.0 item chirps_dekad-202610d3, GDAL returned 51.386661529541 from band 1 at zero-based column 2072, row 1129 of the WFP GeoTIFF. The original Climate Hazards Center GeoTIFF returned the same value. That cell accumulated 51.39 mm over the eleven-day interval. The source NetCDF header specifies mm/dekad and WFP describes accumulated totals.
gap: The public STAC item gives band unit “1”. Interpreting the value required the linked source metadata. This test covers one cell in one collection.

observation: What dry biomass growth rate did PROBA-V V2.0.1 RT0 estimate near Palmira (76.36° W, 3.53° N) for 21–30 June 2020? The public STAC item identifies the 1 km initial estimate and an Int16 DMP band with missing value −1 and scale 0.01. The documented physical unit is kg of dry matter per hectare per day. An anonymous range GET to the exact DMP GeoTIFF returned HTTP 401, “Token not found”. The numerical rate remains unknown.
gap: Reading the stored cell requires an authorised download. A styled RT6 map would introduce a different consolidation stage and could not verify the RT0 cell.

observation: What land-cover class was recorded at a northern Ghana sample point and when? The original feature could not be read. In V1.1 (released 2025-11-21), the published class-table schema reports 68 valid numeric class identifiers spanning 101–1402 with a paired text-name field; these are unitless nominal codes. Release coverage spans 2018–2024 and collection spans 2020–2024. Those dates apply to the release; a point date and coordinates remain unknown. Original V1.1 point GeoPackage and class-table download each returned HTTP 400 requiring Guestbook 306. Public release manifest, class-table DDI and guestbook specification opened.
gap: Guestbook submission is required even though all listed response fields are optional. No form was submitted, no feature value was verified, and the distinct 2026 companion was not substituted.

observation: What is the modelled 1-hour, 200-year rainfall intensity for the grid cell containing Palmira (76.36° W, 3.53° N)? Zenodo identifies BURGER 1.0 (14 August 2025), a 0.1° WGS84 grid in mm/h. Its anonymous record returns an empty file list and its files endpoint returned HTTP 403. Fathom shows a global figure for the requested duration and return period. It does not expose the deposited numeric cell.
gap: The deposited grid requires provider-granted access. The chart and study-wide gauge errors cannot supply a cell intensity in mm/h.

observation: The paper’s Data availability section cites Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16837695 (v1). The v2 provider README explicitly identifies all 16,566 IDMC events and Event ID values as unchanged from v1. An anonymous HTTP range request retrieved and CRC-verified the complete events_viz.json member of the v2 ZIP. It contained 32,464 rows. Event ID 15957 has Source IDMC, ISO3 CYM, Cayman Islands, Date 2008-08-26, Disaster Type Storm and 720 disaster internal displacements. This is a v1-origin observation read via the documented unchanged IDMC subset of v2. Separately, the paper’s Table 3 reports 7,309 storms across 199 countries, an aggregate.
gap: The v1 files remain restricted and Zenodo disables guest and signed-in access requests. The original v1 archive and its EM-DAT values could not be directly verified. V2 removes EM-DAT data other than DisNo. Its README documents retained IDMC displacement values on some linked EM-DAT rows. The provider statement supports provenance for the selected IDMC observation.

observation: WorldCereal JECAM-CIRAD.zip matched MD5 d1e24229728a0734532d4078c8e6f639. All 12 metadata workbooks cite CIRAD DOI 10.18167/DVN1/P7OLAP V2, and the shapefiles contain 18,329 rows. In 2018_SN_JECAM_CIRAD_POLY_111, the original attributes of Id 23964 give Niakhar, Senegal, AcquiDate 2018-09-15, LandCover Cropland, CropType1 Groundnut, CropType2 Cowpea, Intercrop 1 and Area_ha 0.195. The first WGS84 longitude/latitude vertex is (-16.530311, 14.463631). The companion curation PDF reports no corrections or geometry transformations. gap: CIRAD V2.0 and V2.1 describe a deaccessioned 27,074-record release and name BD_JECAM_CIRAD_2021.tar.gz. The full archive was unavailable. The subset attests major V2 only, so the precise patch and direct byte comparison against original files are unverified. The transferred layer describes 31,879 records in a different release.

observation: Which class wins one pixel east of the example? ForTy 2020 v1.0, native 10 m cell centered at 157.55437064°W, 1.86336936°N (zero-based row 3610, column 2399): raw bands [0,116,0,0,0]. The residual Other Land score is 134/250 = 0.536, above Naturally Regenerating Forest at 116/250 = 0.464. The original classification tile independently returned code 6, Other Land. Scores are unitless model confidence. Anonymous producer confidence GeoTIFF and original Figshare classification ZIP both downloaded (HTTP 200).
gap: One native cell and its matching classification were verified. No ground reference was tested.

observation: What probability does model 2026a assign to cocoa at a different West African cell in 2024? Native 10 m mirror band 1 at zero-based row 25, column 25 (5.99773674°W, 4.99773217°N) returned 0.0175223742, about 1.75% model probability that the pixel includes cocoa trees. The mirror's 81,697,833-byte TIFF matched its STAC MD5 a62fc3507d96706216346266407e17fe. Anonymous independent mirror TIFF downloaded. Original Earth Engine asset returned HTTP 401. Both the producer object and release CSV returned HTTP 400 UserProjectMissing (Requester Pays).
gap: The independent mirror identifies the producer object, but byte identity with the producer release remains unconfirmed. Other commodities, years and Forest Persistence were not sampled.
